planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Click the EES link in the navigation (data-testid=nav-ees)
Enter 90 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used)
The traveller days (data-testid=ees-traveller-days) show 64 and a difference (data-testid=ees-difference) of 26 days is reported
